hint.first: First letter of a word revealed.

tutorial.title: How to play Wend

trace.title: Connect the letters
trace.body: Drag your finger through neighbouring letters to form a word. The theme is fruit: start on the {letter} and trace {word} along the top row.

turn.title: Words turn corners
turn.body: A word moves sideways, up and down, never diagonally, and goes around the walls. One fruit of {count} letters is left, and it starts on the {letter}.

tutorial.doneBody: Each letter belongs to exactly one word, and all the words share a theme. A grey trail is only a draft: it takes a colour when the word is right. Tap the first letter of a trail to erase it. The clock starts when the board appears.
